coverage: Report unique named artists separately from successfully queried artists, nonempty native neighborhoods, graph degree, connected components and evaluable references; empty responses retained; exclude unattributed rows and self edges
graph: Undirected pair maximum of native aggregate scores; no fabricated negative edges. Log1p weights, symmetric degree normalization. Pair grouping removes reciprocal evidence together.
interpretation: Recovery of withheld observed co-listening relationships, not listener preference, perceptual music similarity, genre correctness or temporal generalization. Top100 truncation and reference capture expansion create missingness and selection bias; unknown relationships are not proven irrelevant.
metrics: Macro query Recall@10 and@50, MRR, coverage, runtime and peakRSS. Exact uniform expectation uses identical candidate sets. Paired query bootstrap is conditional on predictions, not independence of graph users or population representativeness.
models: 64-dimensional largest-algebraic eigenvector representation of normalized log-weight adjacency, excluding trivial eigenvalues above0.99999; deterministic eigen initialization; cosine ranking
Exact cosine between weighted neighbor profiles (two-hop common-context baseline)
objective: Useful artist discovery at thousands of artists, with no audio, lyrics, track descriptions or per-user histories required
public_scope: Only aggregate native identities, source scores, derived coordinates and compact neighbors can be considered for reviewed promotion; no user data or restricted claims. Existing production retained dataset and map remain intact until a separate certified integration passes.
queries: Successfully captured references with at least5 withheld neighbors and10 retained training neighbors. Candidate set excludes self and every observed training neighbor; withheld source positives are unknown to methods. No query sampling based on outcomes.
ranking_stability: Rank scores rounded to8decimal places, then native-ID order. Retain float64 evaluation vectors. Initial replay found raw floating-point ties unstable across dot-product implementations; this correction applies to all methods and does not tune model parameters.
selection: No tuning of embedding dimension, weights, split or thresholds after viewing metrics. If embedding does not beat the common-context baseline, use direct source neighborhoods or that simpler baseline and retain embeddings only as optional layout coordinates.
source: Bounded native ListenBrainz public session aggregate API, advertised1800day algorithm, one reference per request, at least1.1seconds between starts; exact MBIDs and names; no restricted local source graph projected
split: sha256(artist-graph-pair-holdout-v1: + lexical MBID0 + : + lexical MBID1) modulo5. Fold0 withheld entirely, both directions removed before normalization, fitting or degree baselines. No genre labels used.
